name: 저승 까마귀
quote: 삼도천의 물결이 붉게 물들 때, 셋째 발이 네 심장을 짚으리라.
face: 붉게 빛나는 작은 눈과 날카로운 부리
silhouette: 세 개의 다리, 둥근 몸체, 뾰족한 부리와 날개 끝
signature_motion: 공중에서 급강하하며 세 번째 다리로 낚아채기
signature_vfx: 붉은색 잔상이 남는 빠른 이동 궤적
visual_en: A small, 28px crow-like creature with a medium-saturated bluish-grey body. It features three distinct legs, with the third leg acting as a sharp striking tool. The eyes glow with a piercing, bright red light. Its wings are thick with dark grey feathers, showing slight red tips. The beak is sharp and dark. The overall silhouette is rounded yet sharp, with a prominent third limb and glowing red eyes that stand out against the dark environment.
pose_en: Perched low, ready to spring forward with sudden speed.
vfx_en: A sharp, crimson streak following its rapid dash.
lore: 눈 깜짝할 새에 파고든다(아주 빠르게 파고드는 급습형).
concept: 저승길 — 한국 저승 설화(저승차사 · 옥졸 · 삼도천 · 명부 · 염라). 무섭되 이 게임의 2~3등신 치비 도트, 어두운 돌바닥과 밝은 회색 바닥 둘 다에서 보이는 몸 색.

body_plan.body: A pixelated bird-like creature with dark blue feathers, a black beak, and red eyes, featuring wings and two bird legs.
